If you have seen this title, and count yourself among those liberated few that joined before the mass migrations, then you may very well be wondering what precisely is meant by that question. After all, The growth of Voat has been rather impossible to ignore, and the ballooning of the userbase in any site tends to change it's culture drastically. I'm making this post because I believe that the growth of our userbase, in particular relation to the types of users that found themselves drawn here, has demonstrably changed the culture of the site for the worse and created nothing more than a mirror image of the forces of tyrannical progressivism that the majority of us fled to this site to escape. I'm making this post because I watched a place of genuine discussion be warped and mutilated into nothing more than a cesspool of bigotry and intolerance. I'm making this post because I'm just about fucking sick of expressing basic human decency and being greeted with nothing but name-calling in response.

If such an opener leads to you questioning my own personal views, then it would be perhaps a wise practice to outline what beliefs I have. If there is anything I can say about them, it is that they are not in service of a foul agenda, but instead concordances with what I believe to be values of basic humanity and decency. I believe in the right of all human beings to live their lives as freely and fufillingly as they can. I believe that nothing good can ever come out of suppressing the parts of ourselves that can bring us great happiness and fulfillment if we carry about them ethically. I believe that any human in the world, no matter their differences of color, creed, sex or nature, should fully be allowed to carry out whatever course they may, as long as it brings no pointless suffering onto themselves or others. Above all, I believe that the essential nature of good is the nature of reducing unnecessary suffering in the world, and that any who say otherwise are bound for unnecessary torment at best, or the foulest evil at worst. Yet those same values that first drew me to this site, which lead to my principled opposition to many of the foul kind that cloak their evil and tyranny under cloth of progressiveness and false tolerance, have made me an outsider as this site has seemingly become twisted to the service of the hateful, the bigoted, and the cruelly intolerant.

In the beginning of my time on this site, Voat had promise. It was a place free of the tyrannical silencing of genuine thought and freedom that plagued many other hubs of discussion. It was a place where many differing creeds could come together in spirit of respect, with freedom assured and the right of all to speak their piece freely respected. It was a place where tolerance of view was a sacrosanct covenant. It was a place where the keepers who devoted themselves to allowing free and open discussion to take place unimpeded by hate and base ignorance were mindful of their responsibilities and accountable to the users. Yet as my time here wore on, I saw this culture of mindfulness and respect for every reasoned and genuine sentiment twisted into a culture of hatred and bigotry that spat on its former values.

The willingness to entertain controversial views became a tyranny of the majority that forsaked the culture of free speech in favour of unthinking ignorance and hatred.

The respect for the reasoned opinions of your opponents was strangled in its bed and replaced by a foul dogma that labelled those who opposed it for even the best of reasons as the worst and most feeble of humanity.

The absolute opposition towards any hivemind was replaced by a hivemind that presented nothing more than unthinking and uncritical acceptance of anything that played into the prejudices of the dogma, no matter how cruel, hateful or unreasoned it revealed itself as.

The site I once knew, so free and full of promise, was warped into nothing more than a twisted mirror of its opposition, answering thoughtlessness with thoughtlessness rather than genuine critical thinking.

And in doing so, we became no better than that which we came to this place to escape from.

You should be *so **fucking** proud* of what you've all accomplished here.

If you have any respect at all for the values that drew us here in the first place, then I honestly think you should count yourself the last of a dying breed here, and for good reason. Instead of questioning all views to ensure that they stood up to the test of verification, we latched on to a dogma of mindless opposition to our opponents with no heed payed to genuine truth or care for the rights of our fellow human beings. Instead of creating a space where anyone is inexorably free to speak their piece and have those beliefs that stood up to scrutiny respected, we adopted a dogma of hatred and thoughtlessness that violently silenced even its most principled and verifiable critics. Instead of creating a space where everyone was held accountable for their ideas and actions no matter their place on this site, we created a space where the censorship was done by the hateful masses rather than a tyrannical few. And it seemed that anyone with any power to stop or limit this just seemingly sat back and did **absolutely fucking nothing**.

What grounds do you have to complain when you chose to part of the problem, rather than choosing to create a solution to that which the principles of Voat stand in opposition of?

For what it's worth, I acknowledge that this is not universally true of the users who populate this site, and I have nothing but respect for those who stubbornly carry on the dream of what Voat could have been. Maybe this site genuinely still is possible to save. I certainly hope so. But there is a limit to how much I can put myself through in service of ideals and principles that the majority of this site seems to have absolutely no respect for. I've tried to be the change I wish to see in this site, but I can't keep coming up with reasons to continue when every attempt is met with overwhelming scorn. It's *fucking* excruciating trying to advocate for spaces of genuine discussion when all this site seemingly wants is an echo chamber. It's *fucking* exhausting to exercise basic human decency and be met with seemingly nothing but ridicule and hateful slurs. It's *fucking* demoralizing to continue to try and open minds characterized by their blinkered refusal to do so. I want to save Voat, but it seems to continually reject any attempts at doing so.

Whatever happened to the Voat of yesteryear?

From what I gathered, it was violated, mutilated, and ultimately warped into a **fucking** cesspit while the only people who could do anything to stop it seemingly stood back and let it **fucking** happen.

Is it so fucking unreasonable to hold to the values this site was founded upon in the first place?

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

*Laconic version*: Voat is seemingly nothing more than a hateful mirror of our opponents, anyone who could do or could have already done something about this is seemingly just standing back at letting this place go to the dogs, and I'm fucking tired of trying to uphold the values that drew many of us here in the first place and being met with nothing but scorn. Why should I even stay here when every reasoned point I make is met with almost nothing but hate?
Whatever happened to the Voat of yesteryear?

The causes of the exoduses support this thesis, as you touched on. As such, while it's entirely possible for the site to regain the exposure it would need to once again attract those more capable of mature discourse, this is sadly unlikely as the current content and userbase will simply deter them once again. Additionally, since the site's owners appear to follow a policy of non-intervention (and perhaps for good reason, though I've seen this suspended at times) it's unlikely any nudge will come from that very influential source.
